# The tests that fail BY DESIGN when the whole suite is run with
# TENANCY_ROLES_PER_ORGANISATION=true ("one login, a role at each organisation"
# switched on). Read by scripts/junit-expected-failures.php; the run passes only
# when exactly these fail.
#
# Each is an existing test that pins the SWITCHED-OFF behaviour without setting the
# switch, and is deliberately left unedited: together they are the proof that a
# school and a login untouched by the feature run what they always ran. With the
# switch on, every school's Teachers screen runs one path
# (TeachersController::createOrAttachWithClassSubjects, and resolveTeacher()'s read
# of the row's role), which costs ONE more statement on add, edit and remove, and
# the Teachers door attaches a live lunch-staff login instead of refusing it.
#
# If a test here starts to pass, or another starts to fail, the switched-on path
# moved: look before changing this list, and say why in the commit.

# One more statement on edit: resolveTeacher() reads the row's role (a lunch person
# of this organisation is not a teacher on its Teachers screen).
Tests\Feature\ClassSubjectsOffSqlTest :: it preserves literal main statement order with at most one primary key capability select with data set "('teacher update')"

# One more statement on add: the school's row lock that the shared attach path takes.
Tests\Feature\ClassSubjectsOffSqlTest :: it preserves literal main statement order with at most one primary key capability select with data set "('teacher invite')"

# One more statement on remove: the same read of the row's role.
Tests\Feature\TimetableGlobalAccountOffTest :: it Timetable unused OFF school teacher removal matches literal base SQL

# The refusal the feature removes: a live lunch-staff login is now made a teacher
# (201) where this case pins 422. Its switched-on behaviour is pinned in
# OneLoginTwoRolesDoorsTest.
Tests\Feature\TeacherAttachTest :: A login of any other type is refused and nothing is written with data set "LunchStaff"
